dog.description_text:
Susan is a 1-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 25 lbs and has the most unique little face, with markings that make her instantly recognizable. She’s a sweet, gentle girl with a very affectionate side, and once she feels comfortable, she’s a total lovebug.

She’s still building confidence with some everyday things, including stairs, so Susan will do best with a patient adopter who is happy to help her learn at her own pace. With love, consistency, and a little understanding, she has every chance to keep feeling safer and braver in the world around her.

Registered adopters interested in Susan can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
